# Helpers

```{r}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
stopf <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

ptrap_labels <- c(
  "1" = "handwashing p-trap 1",
  "2" = "tap water p-trap",
  "3" = "handwashing p-trap 2"
)

ptrap_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#1b9e77",
  "2" = "#7570b3",
  "3" = "#d95f02"
)

extract_tax_rank <- function(x, rank_prefix = "g__") {
  out <- sub(paste0(".*", rank_prefix, "([^;]+).*"), "\\1", x)
  out[!grepl(rank_prefix, x, fixed = TRUE)] <- NA_character_
  out <- str_squish(out)
  out[out %in% c("", "NA", "uncultured", "unclassified", "metagenome")] <- NA_character_
  out
}

make_16s_tax_label <- function(taxon_vec, tax_level = c("genus", "species")) {
  tax_level <- match.arg(tax_level)

  if (tax_level == "genus") {
    out <- extract_tax_rank(taxon_vec, "g__")
    out <- str_squish(out)
    out[out %in% c("", "NA", "uncultured", "unclassified", "metagenome")] <- NA_character_
    return(out)
  }

  genus   <- extract_tax_rank(taxon_vec, "g__")
  species <- extract_tax_rank(taxon_vec, "s__")

  genus   <- str_squish(genus)
  species <- str_squish(species)
  species[species %in% c("", "NA", "uncultured", "unclassified", "metagenome")] <- NA_character_

  out <- ifelse(
    !is.na(species) & !is.na(genus) &
      str_detect(species, regex(paste0("^", stringr::fixed(genus), "\\s+"), ignore_case = FALSE)),
    species,
    ifelse(!is.na(species) & !is.na(genus), paste(genus, species), NA_character_)
  )

  out <- str_squish(out)
  out <- sub("^([A-Za-z]+)\\s+\\1\\s+", "\\1 ", out)
  out[!str_detect(out, regex("^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9._-]+\\s+(sp\\.?|[a-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]+)$"))] <- NA_character_
  out
}

make_mg_tax_label <- function(x, tax_level = c("genus", "species")) {
  tax_level <- match.arg(tax_level)
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "uncultured", "unclassified", "metagenome")] <- NA_character_

  if (tax_level == "species") {
    return(x)
  }

  out <- ifelse(
    str_detect(x, "^Candidatus\\s+"),
    str_replace(x, "^(Candidatus\\s+\\S+).*$", "\\1"),
    word(x, 1)
  )

  out <- str_squish(out)
  out[out %in% c("", "NA", "uncultured", "unclassified", "metagenome")] <- NA_character_
  out
}

renormalize_ra <- function(df, sample_cols) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  cs <- colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  cs[cs == 0] <- NA_real_
  mat <- sweep(mat, 2, cs, "/")
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  df[, sample_cols] <- mat
  df
}

aggregate_ra_by_tax <- function(df, taxon_col, sample_cols) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[taxon_col]]), .data[[taxon_col]] != "") %>%
    group_by(.data[[taxon_col]]) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(sample_cols), ~ sum(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(taxon_label = all_of(taxon_col))
}

ra_tbl_to_sample_tax_mat <- function(agg_tbl, sample_cols) {
  tax_mat <- agg_tbl %>%
    column_to_rownames("taxon_label") %>%
    as.matrix()
  tax_mat <- tax_mat[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE]
  storage.mode(tax_mat) <- "numeric"
  t(tax_mat)
}

compute_halfmin_pseudo <- function(x, fallback = 1e-8) {
  pos <- as.numeric(x)
  pos <- pos[is.finite(pos) & pos > 0]
  if (length(pos) == 0) return(fallback)
  min(pos) / 2
}

clr_transform <- function(sample_tax_mat, pseudo = NULL, fallback = 1e-8) {
  x <- as.matrix(sample_tax_mat)
  if (is.null(pseudo)) {
    pseudo <- compute_halfmin_pseudo(x, fallback = fallback)
  }
  x <- x + pseudo
  row_gm <- exp(rowMeans(log(x)))
  out <- sweep(log(x), 1, log(row_gm), "-")
  attr(out, "pseudocount") <- pseudo
  out
}

month_lookup <- c(
  Jan = "01", Feb = "02", Mar = "03", Apr = "04", May = "05", Jun = "06",
  Jul = "07", Aug = "08", Sep = "09", Oct = "10", Nov = "11", Dec = "12"
)

parse_mg_sample_names <- function(sample_names, year = 2024L) {
  pat <- "^(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)(\\d{2})_(\\d+)_([A-Za-z]+)$"
  m <- str_match(sample_names, pat)

  bad <- is.na(m[, 1])
  if (any(bad)) {
    stopf(
      "These metagenomic sample names do not match the expected pattern 'Jun17_1_S': %s",
      paste(sample_names[bad], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  tibble(
    mg_sample   = sample_names,
    month_abbr  = m[, 2],
    day         = m[, 3],
    ptrap       = as.integer(m[, 4]),
    mg_state    = m[, 5],
    date        = as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month_lookup[m[, 2]], "-", m[, 3]))
  )
}

sample_name_priority <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "_re2$") ~ -100,
    !str_detect(x, "_(di|re)") ~ 50,
    str_detect(x, "_di(\\.low)?$") ~ 40,
    str_detect(x, "_re(\\.low)?$") ~ 30,
    TRUE ~ 10
  )
}

pick_one_16s_per_date_ptrap <- function(meta_tbl) {
  meta_tbl %>%
    mutate(
      rest_priority = coalesce(as.numeric(resting_time), -Inf),
      name_priority = sample_name_priority(Sample.Name),
      order_priority = -coalesce(as.numeric(Sample.Order), 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(date, ptrap, desc(rest_priority), desc(name_priority), desc(order_priority), Sample.Name) %>%
    group_by(date, ptrap) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
}

platform_mean_table <- function(sample_tax_16s, sample_tax_mg, pseudo = 1e-6) {
  common_taxa <- intersect(colnames(sample_tax_16s), colnames(sample_tax_mg))
  tibble(
    taxon_label = common_taxa,
    mean_16S = colMeans(sample_tax_16s[, common_taxa, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_MG  = colMeans(sample_tax_mg[, common_taxa, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      joint_mean = (mean_16S + mean_MG) / 2,
      log10_mean_16S = log10(mean_16S + pseudo),
      log10_mean_MG  = log10(mean_MG + pseudo)
    )
}

safe_spearman <- function(x, y) {
  suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
}

safe_pearson <- function(x, y) {
  suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
}

safe_cor_test_p <- function(x, y, method = "spearman") {
  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = method, exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  out
}

orient_pca_pc1_to_time <- function(pca_obj, sample_meta) {
  scores <- as.data.frame(pca_obj$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("mg_sample") %>%
    left_join(sample_meta, by = "mg_sample")

  rho <- safe_spearman(scores$PC1, scores$day_num)
  sgn <- ifelse(is.na(rho) || rho >= 0, 1, -1)

  pca_obj$x[, 1] <- pca_obj$x[, 1] * sgn
  pca_obj$rotation[, 1] <- pca_obj$rotation[, 1] * sgn

  list(
    pca = pca_obj,
    sign_pc1 = sgn
  )
}

as_cached_score_df <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)

  if (inherits(obj, "prcomp")) {
    if (is.null(obj$x)) return(NULL)
    df <- as.data.frame(obj$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
    if (!is.null(rownames(df)) && any(nzchar(rownames(df)))) {
      df$Sample.Name <- rownames(df)
    }
  } else if (is.data.frame(obj) || is.matrix(obj)) {
    df <- as.data.frame(obj)
    sample_col <- intersect(c("Sample.Name", "sample", "sample_name", "Sample", "id"), names(df))
    if (length(sample_col) > 0) {
      df$Sample.Name <- as.character(df[[sample_col[1]]])
    } else if (!is.null(rownames(df)) && any(nzchar(rownames(df)))) {
      df$Sample.Name <- rownames(df)
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }

  pc1_col <- intersect(c("PC1", "Axis1", "axis1", "Dim1"), names(df))
  pc2_col <- intersect(c("PC2", "Axis2", "axis2", "Dim2"), names(df))

  if (length(pc1_col) == 0 || length(pc2_col) == 0) {
    num_cols <- names(df)[vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))]
    num_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, c("ptrap", "resting_time", "week", "day_num"))
    if (length(num_cols) < 2) return(NULL)
    pc1_col <- num_cols[1]
    pc2_col <- num_cols[2]
  } else {
    pc1_col <- pc1_col[1]
    pc2_col <- pc2_col[1]
  }

  tibble(
    Sample.Name = as.character(df$Sample.Name),
    PC1 = as.numeric(df[[pc1_col]]),
    PC2 = as.numeric(df[[pc2_col]])
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Sample.Name))
}

get_cached_16s_scores <- function(cache, use_16s_batch = "25") {
  candidates <- switch(
    use_16s_batch,
    "25" = list(cache$scores_25_ptrap),
    "35_all" = list(cache$scores_35_all),
    "35_hc" = list(cache$scores_35_hc),
    list()
  )

  for (obj in candidates) {
    out <- tryCatch(as_cached_score_df(obj), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(out) && nrow(out) > 0) return(out)
  }
  NULL
}

compute_axis_summary <- function(scores_df, platform_name) {
  rho_pc1_day <- safe_spearman(scores_df$PC1, scores_df$day_num)
  p_pc1_day   <- safe_cor_test_p(scores_df$PC1, scores_df$day_num, method = "spearman")
  pear_pc1_day <- safe_pearson(scores_df$PC1, scores_df$day_num)

  if (length(unique(scores_df$ptrap)) == 2) {
    p_pc2_ptrap <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(PC2 ~ factor(ptrap), data = scores_df)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    delta_pc2 <- scores_df %>%
      group_by(ptrap) %>%
      summarise(m = mean(PC2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(ptrap)
    delta_pc2 <- if (nrow(delta_pc2) == 2) diff(delta_pc2$m) else NA_real_
  } else {
    p_pc2_ptrap <- tryCatch(kruskal.test(PC2 ~ factor(ptrap), data = scores_df)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    delta_pc2 <- NA_real_
  }

  tibble(
    platform = platform_name,
    n_samples = nrow(scores_df),
    pc1_day_spearman = rho_pc1_day,
    pc1_day_spearman_p = p_pc1_day,
    pc1_day_pearson = pear_pc1_day,
    pc2_ptrap_p = p_pc2_ptrap,
    pc2_ptrap_mean_diff_high_minus_low = delta_pc2
  )
}

compute_taxon_axis_association <- function(clr_mat, sample_tax_mat, scores_df, platform_name, pseudo = 1e-6) {
  taxa <- colnames(clr_mat)

  tibble(
    taxon_label = taxa,
    platform = platform_name,
    mean_abundance = colMeans(sample_tax_mat[, taxa, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence = colMeans(sample_tax_mat[, taxa, drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    cor_with_pc1 = map_dbl(taxa, ~ safe_spearman(clr_mat[, .x], scores_df$PC1)),
    p_with_pc1 = map_dbl(taxa, ~ safe_cor_test_p(clr_mat[, .x], scores_df$PC1, method = "spearman")),
    cor_with_day = map_dbl(taxa, ~ safe_spearman(clr_mat[, .x], scores_df$day_num)),
    p_with_day = map_dbl(taxa, ~ safe_cor_test_p(clr_mat[, .x], scores_df$day_num, method = "spearman"))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      abs_cor_with_pc1 = abs(cor_with_pc1),
      abs_cor_with_day = abs(cor_with_day),
      log10_mean_abundance = log10(mean_abundance + pseudo)
    )
}

```

# Load cache and metagenomic table

```{r}
if (!file.exists(part1_cache_file)) {
  stopf("part1 cache not found: %s", part1_cache_file)
}
if (!file.exists(mg_table_file)) {
  stopf("metagenomic taxonomy table not found: %s", mg_table_file)
}

cache <- readRDS(part1_cache_file)

required_cache_names <- c(
  "id_cols", "meta_25_ptrap", "ra_25_ptrap",
  "meta_35_ptrap", "ra_35_ptrap",
  "meta_35_ptrap_hc", "ra_35_ptrap_hc"
)
missing_cache <- setdiff(required_cache_names, names(cache))
if (length(missing_cache) > 0) {
  message("Part1 cache is missing some optional names: ", paste(missing_cache, collapse = ", "))
}

id_cols <- cache$id_cols %||% c("Sequence", "Taxon", "id", "Consensus")

if (use_16s_batch == "25") {
  meta_16s <- cache$meta_25_ptrap
  ra_16s   <- cache$ra_25_ptrap
} else if (use_16s_batch == "35_all") {
  meta_16s <- cache$meta_35_ptrap
  ra_16s   <- cache$ra_35_ptrap
} else if (use_16s_batch == "35_hc") {
  meta_16s <- cache$meta_35_ptrap_hc
  ra_16s   <- cache$ra_35_ptrap_hc
} else {
  stopf("Unknown use_16s_batch: %s", use_16s_batch)
}

if (is.null(meta_16s) || is.null(ra_16s)) {
  stopf("Failed to load the requested 16S objects from the cache for batch '%s'.", use_16s_batch)
}

mg_raw <- read.delim(mg_table_file, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (ncol(mg_raw) < 2) {
  stopf("Metagenomic table has fewer than 2 columns: %s", mg_table_file)
}

mg_tax_col     <- names(mg_raw)[1]
mg_sample_cols <- setdiff(names(mg_raw), mg_tax_col)

mg_raw[mg_sample_cols] <- lapply(mg_raw[mg_sample_cols], as.numeric)
mg_meta <- parse_mg_sample_names(mg_sample_cols, year = 2024L)

if (!is.null(restrict_ptraps)) {
  mg_meta <- mg_meta %>% filter(ptrap %in% restrict_ptraps)
}
mg_sample_cols <- mg_meta$mg_sample
```

# Build date/ptrap sample map

```{r}
meta_16s_sub <- meta_16s %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  filter(ptrap %in% unique(mg_meta$ptrap), date %in% unique(mg_meta$date))

picked_16s <- pick_one_16s_per_date_ptrap(meta_16s_sub)

mg_meta$ptrap = as.factor(mg_meta$ptrap)

sample_map <- mg_meta %>%
  left_join(
    picked_16s %>%
      select(date, ptrap, Sample.Name, Phenotype, resting_time, week, dow),
    by = c("date", "ptrap")
  ) %>%
  arrange(date, ptrap)

if (any(is.na(sample_map$Sample.Name))) {
  warning(
    "Some metagenomic samples could not be matched to a 16S sample by date + ptrap.\n",
    "Unmatched rows:\n",
    paste(capture.output(print(sample_map %>% filter(is.na(Sample.Name)))), collapse = "\n")
  )
}

sample_map_use <- sample_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sample.Name)) %>%
  mutate(day_num = as.numeric(date - min(date, na.rm = TRUE)))

if (nrow(sample_map_use) < 4) {
  stopf("Too few matched overlap samples after date/ptrap matching: n = %d", nrow(sample_map_use))
}
```

# Prepare 16S table

```{r}
keep_16s_samples <- unique(sample_map_use$Sample.Name)
keep_mg_samples  <- unique(sample_map_use$mg_sample)

sample_map_use2 <- sample_map_use %>%
  distinct(mg_sample, Sample.Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

ra_16s_use <- ra_16s %>%
  select(any_of(c(id_cols, keep_16s_samples)))

if (!"Taxon" %in% names(ra_16s_use)) {
  stopf("The 16S abundance table does not contain a 'Taxon' column.")
}

ra_16s_use <- ra_16s_use %>%
  mutate(taxon_label = make_16s_tax_label(Taxon, tax_level = tax_level))

ra_16s_agg <- aggregate_ra_by_tax(
  df = ra_16s_use,
  taxon_col = "taxon_label",
  sample_cols = keep_16s_samples
)

rename_to_mg <- setNames(sample_map_use2$Sample.Name, sample_map_use2$mg_sample)
ra_16s_agg <- ra_16s_agg %>% rename(all_of(rename_to_mg))
ra_16s_agg <- ra_16s_agg %>% select(taxon_label, all_of(sample_map_use2$mg_sample))
ra_16s_agg <- renormalize_ra(ra_16s_agg, sample_map_use2$mg_sample)
```

# Prepare metagenomic table

```{r}
mg_use <- mg_raw %>%
  rename(raw_taxon = all_of(mg_tax_col)) %>%
  select(raw_taxon, all_of(keep_mg_samples)) %>%
  mutate(taxon_label = make_mg_tax_label(raw_taxon, tax_level = tax_level))

mg_agg <- aggregate_ra_by_tax(
  df = mg_use,
  taxon_col = "taxon_label",
  sample_cols = keep_mg_samples
)
mg_agg <- renormalize_ra(mg_agg, keep_mg_samples)
```

# Intersect taxa and build sample x taxon matrices

```{r}
common_taxa <- intersect(ra_16s_agg$taxon_label, mg_agg$taxon_label)
if (length(common_taxa) < 10) {
  stopf(
    "Only %d common taxa were found between 16S and metagenomic tables at tax_level = '%s'. Try tax_level = 'genus'.",
    length(common_taxa), tax_level
  )
}

ra_16s_common <- ra_16s_agg %>% filter(taxon_label %in% common_taxa)
mg_common     <- mg_agg     %>% filter(taxon_label %in% common_taxa)

sample_order <- sample_map_use2 %>%
  distinct(mg_sample, date, ptrap, day_num) %>%
  arrange(date, ptrap) %>%
  pull(mg_sample)

# Platform-specific matrices used for PCA and genus-level associations.
sample_tax_16s_pca <- ra_tbl_to_sample_tax_mat(ra_16s_agg, sample_order)
sample_tax_mg_pca  <- ra_tbl_to_sample_tax_mat(mg_agg,      sample_order)
sample_tax_mg_pca <- sample_tax_mg_pca[
  , colMeans(sample_tax_mg_pca, na.rm = TRUE) >= min_mg_pca_mean_abund,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Cross-platform taxon summaries use the shared genus subcomposition.
sample_tax_16s <- ra_tbl_to_sample_tax_mat(ra_16s_common, sample_order)
sample_tax_mg  <- ra_tbl_to_sample_tax_mat(mg_common,     sample_order)

joint_means <- platform_mean_table(sample_tax_16s, sample_tax_mg, pseudo = pseudo) %>%
  arrange(desc(joint_mean))

keep_taxa <- joint_means %>%
  filter(joint_mean >= min_joint_mean_abund) %>%
  pull(taxon_label)

if (length(keep_taxa) < 10) {
  keep_taxa <- head(joint_means$taxon_label, 25)
}

sample_tax_16s <- sample_tax_16s[, keep_taxa, drop = FALSE]
sample_tax_mg  <- sample_tax_mg[, keep_taxa, drop = FALSE]
```

# Cross-platform consistency summaries

```{r}
mean_tbl <- platform_mean_table(sample_tax_16s, sample_tax_mg, pseudo = pseudo) %>%
  arrange(desc(joint_mean))

write.csv(mean_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "top_taxa_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

spearman_taxa <- suppressWarnings(cor(mean_tbl$mean_16S, mean_tbl$mean_MG, method = "spearman"))
pearson_taxa  <- suppressWarnings(cor(log10(mean_tbl$mean_16S + pseudo), log10(mean_tbl$mean_MG + pseudo), method = "pearson"))

```


# PCA time-axis

```{r}
clr_16s_platform <- clr_transform(sample_tax_16s_pca, pseudo = NULL, fallback = clr_pseudo_fallback)
clr_mg_pca  <- clr_transform(sample_tax_mg_pca, pseudo = mg_pca_pseudocount, fallback = clr_pseudo_fallback)
clr_16s_platform_pseudo <- attr(clr_16s_platform, "pseudocount")
clr_mg_pca_pseudo  <- attr(clr_mg_pca, "pseudocount")

sample_meta_ordered <- sample_map_use2 %>%
  distinct(mg_sample, Sample.Name, date, ptrap, mg_state, day_num) %>%
  arrange(match(mg_sample, sample_order))

cached_scores_16s_all <- get_cached_16s_scores(cache, use_16s_batch)
if (is.null(cached_scores_16s_all)) {
  stop("Cached 16S PCA scores were not found.")
}
used_cached_16s_pca <- TRUE

scores_16s <- sample_meta_ordered %>%
  left_join(cached_scores_16s_all, by = "Sample.Name")
if (any(is.na(scores_16s$PC1)) || any(is.na(scores_16s$PC2))) {
  stop("Cached 16S PCA scores were found, but some overlap samples could not be matched by Sample.Name.")
}
rho_16s_pc1_day <- safe_spearman(scores_16s$PC1, scores_16s$day_num)
sgn_16s <- ifelse(is.na(rho_16s_pc1_day) || rho_16s_pc1_day >= 0, 1, -1)
scores_16s <- scores_16s %>%
  mutate(PC1 = PC1 * sgn_16s, platform = "16S")

pca_mg_raw  <- prcomp(clr_mg_pca, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pca_mg_oriented  <- orient_pca_pc1_to_time(pca_mg_raw,  sample_meta_ordered %>% select(-Sample.Name))
pca_mg  <- pca_mg_oriented$pca

scores_mg <- as.data.frame(pca_mg$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("mg_sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta_ordered, by = "mg_sample") %>%
  mutate(platform = "Metagenome")

axis_summary_16s <- compute_axis_summary(scores_16s, "16S")
axis_summary_mg  <- compute_axis_summary(scores_mg,  "Metagenome")
axis_summary_tbl <- bind_rows(axis_summary_16s, axis_summary_mg)
write.csv(axis_summary_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "pca_axis_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_pc1_day_16s <- ggplot(scores_16s, aes(x = date, y = PC1, color = factor(ptrap))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = format(date, "%b%d")), size = 3, max.overlaps = 100) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ptrap_colors, labels = ptrap_labels, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(title = "16S amplicon PC1 vs time", x = "Date", y = "Overlap-only PC1 score", color = "p-trap")

p_pc1_day_mg <- ggplot(scores_mg, aes(x = date, y = PC1, color = factor(ptrap))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = format(date, "%b%d")), size = 3, max.overlaps = 100) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ptrap_colors, labels = ptrap_labels, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(title = "Metagenome PC1 vs time", x = "Date", y = "Overlap-only PC1 score", color = "p-trap")

```

```{r}
assoc_16s <- compute_taxon_axis_association(
  clr_mat = clr_16s_platform,
  sample_tax_mat = sample_tax_16s_pca,
  scores_df = scores_16s,
  platform_name = "16S",
  pseudo = pseudo
)

assoc_mg <- compute_taxon_axis_association(
  clr_mat = clr_mg_pca,
  sample_tax_mat = sample_tax_mg_pca,
  scores_df = scores_mg,
  platform_name = "Metagenome",
  pseudo = pseudo
)

assoc_tbl <- bind_rows(assoc_16s, assoc_mg)
write.csv(assoc_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "taxon_time_axis_association_long.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

assoc_compare <- assoc_16s %>%
  select(
    taxon_label,
    mean_abundance_16s = mean_abundance,
    prevalence_16s = prevalence,
    cor_with_pc1_16s = cor_with_pc1,
    p_with_pc1_16s = p_with_pc1,
    cor_with_day_16s = cor_with_day,
    p_with_day_16s = p_with_day
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    assoc_mg %>%
      select(
        taxon_label,
        mean_abundance_mg = mean_abundance,
        prevalence_mg = prevalence,
        cor_with_pc1_mg = cor_with_pc1,
        p_with_pc1_mg = p_with_pc1,
        cor_with_day_mg = cor_with_day,
        p_with_day_mg = p_with_day
      ),
    by = "taxon_label"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(taxon_label %in% keep_taxa) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_abs_pc1_assoc = (abs(cor_with_pc1_16s) + abs(cor_with_pc1_mg)) / 2,
    avg_abs_day_assoc = (abs(cor_with_day_16s) + abs(cor_with_day_mg)) / 2,
    sign_concordant_pc1 = sign(cor_with_pc1_16s) == sign(cor_with_pc1_mg),
    sign_concordant_day = sign(cor_with_day_16s) == sign(cor_with_day_mg)
  ) %>%
  left_join(mean_tbl %>% select(taxon_label, joint_mean), by = "taxon_label") %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_abs_pc1_assoc), desc(joint_mean))

# Keep up to 20 abundant genera detected in both platforms.
assoc_compare_detected <- assoc_compare %>%
  filter(
    mean_abundance_16s > 0,
    mean_abundance_mg > 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(joint_mean)) %>%
  slice_head(n = assoc_top_n)

pc1_assoc_spearman <- safe_spearman(assoc_compare_detected$cor_with_pc1_16s, assoc_compare_detected$cor_with_pc1_mg)
pc1_assoc_pearson  <- safe_pearson(assoc_compare_detected$cor_with_pc1_16s, assoc_compare_detected$cor_with_pc1_mg)
day_assoc_spearman <- safe_spearman(assoc_compare_detected$cor_with_day_16s, assoc_compare_detected$cor_with_day_mg)

assoc_summary_tbl <- tibble(
  use_16s_batch = use_16s_batch,
  tax_level = tax_level,
  used_cached_16s_pca = used_cached_16s_pca,
  clr_pseudocount_16s = clr_16s_platform_pseudo,
  clr_pseudocount_mg = clr_mg_pca_pseudo,
  n_matched_samples = nrow(sample_map_use2),
  n_common_taxa_after_filter = ncol(sample_tax_16s),
  n_taxa_for_cross_platform_association = nrow(assoc_compare_detected),
  assoc_top_n = assoc_top_n,
  association_requires_nonzero_both = TRUE,
  spearman_taxon_mean = unname(spearman_taxa),
  pearson_log10_taxon_mean = unname(pearson_taxa),
  pc1_day_spearman_16s = axis_summary_16s$pc1_day_spearman,
  pc1_day_p_16s = axis_summary_16s$pc1_day_spearman_p,
  pc1_day_spearman_mg = axis_summary_mg$pc1_day_spearman,
  pc1_day_p_mg = axis_summary_mg$pc1_day_spearman_p,
  pc1_assoc_spearman = pc1_assoc_spearman,
  pc1_assoc_pearson = pc1_assoc_pearson,
  day_assoc_spearman = day_assoc_spearman,
  frac_sign_concordant_pc1 = mean(assoc_compare_detected$sign_concordant_pc1, na.rm = TRUE),
  frac_sign_concordant_day = mean(assoc_compare_detected$sign_concordant_day, na.rm = TRUE)
)

assoc_summary_tbl
```

p_assoc_scatter <- ggplot(assoc_compare_detected, aes(x = cor_with_pc1_16s, y = cor_with_pc1_mg)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +

validation_bundle <- list(
  params = list(
    use_16s_batch = use_16s_batch,
    tax_level = tax_level,
    pseudo = pseudo,
    clr_pseudocount_16s_platform = clr_16s_platform_pseudo,
    clr_pseudocount_mg_pca = clr_mg_pca_pseudo,
    restrict_ptraps = restrict_ptraps,
    min_joint_mean_abund = min_joint_mean_abund,
    min_mg_pca_mean_abund = min_mg_pca_mean_abund,
    mg_pca_pseudocount = mg_pca_pseudocount,
    assoc_top_n = assoc_top_n
  ),
  sample_map = sample_map,
  sample_map_use = sample_map_use2,
  mean_tbl = mean_tbl,
  axis_summary_tbl = axis_summary_tbl,
  assoc_summary_tbl = assoc_summary_tbl,
  assoc_compare = assoc_compare,
  assoc_compare_detected = assoc_compare_detected,
  sample_tax_16s = sample_tax_16s,
  sample_tax_mg = sample_tax_mg,
  sample_tax_16s_pca = sample_tax_16s_pca,
  sample_tax_mg_pca = sample_tax_mg_pca,
  clr_16s_platform = clr_16s_platform,
  clr_mg_pca = clr_mg_pca,

  scores_mg = scores_mg,

)
